notes:
TrackingSheet is a CONTROLLED PRESENTATIONAL surface (no api-client import, no data fetching). Props: { vm: TrackVm, descriptor: HeadlineDescriptor, orderId: string|null, cancel: UseCancelOrderResult, ratingSlot?: ReactNode }. Local UI state only: open (Escape → close) and showCancelDialog. (Round 2: the dead `expanded` state + collapse-first handleClose branch were removed per impl-review; the sheet is always collapsed, so BottomSheet is passed `expanded={false}`.)

Content switches on descriptor.PHASE (not the flags), per advisor: assigned/arrived render vehicle, inProgress/completed render dropoff. The assigned headline (assignedEta/assignedNoEta) ALREADY contains driver name + ETA, so NO separate ETA line is rendered (would duplicate) — the vehicle line is the only extra. Flags gate only what they own: (showCancel && orderId) → Cancel button; showAcceptedHint → CancelDialog hint; showRating → rating slot.

PRICE TRAP (advisor F1): the completed template 'customer.tracking.headline.completed' = 'Hotovo – {{price}} Kč' already contains ' Kč'. Fed a cs-CZ grouped NUMBER (Intl.NumberFormat('cs-CZ',{maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(price)), NOT formatCzk (which would append a 2nd ' Kč' → 'Hotovo – 1 200 Kč Kč'). Ports StatusHeadline's values transform verbatim. Since e2e only regexes /Hotovo/, the component test asserts the exact single-Kč string.

EVERY phase renders the descriptor headline as an aria-live=polite <h2> so e2e getByRole('heading',{name}) resolves the load-bearing strings: 'Hledáme řidiče…' (U+2026), /Řidič.*je na cestě/, 'Objednávka byla zrušena', /Hotovo/ — asserted with the same strings the e2e uses (customer.spec.ts:126/134/212/280).

Reuse-as-is: BottomSheet (role=dialog, ariaLabelKey='customer.tracking.sheetLabel'→'Stav jízdy', Escape, focus-in-on-open), SearchingLoader (role=status, prefers-reduced-motion), CancelDialog (aria-labelledby → dialog name 'Zrušit objednávku?', distinct from the sheet's 'Stav jízdy' name — two dialogs coexist harmlessly when cancel is open). Cancel mutation is NOT duplicated — the injected useCancelOrder result is passed through; onConfirm branches on the returned boolean (not the captured errorKey) so the dialog stays open on failure.

Re-order CTA is a react-router <Link to='/customer'> (real <a href>, ≥48px via theme.touchTargets.min); tests wrap in MemoryRouter (advisor F3).

TrackVm is unchanged (WI-1 froze it) — it has dropoffAddress but no pickupAddress, so the completed 'ride summary' shows the dropoff only (advisor F4); no prop added.

48px targets: Cancel button + re-order link both use theme.touchTargets.min — verified by construction (theme token, the a11y-rule-endorsed mechanism + manual Lighthouse). No getComputedStyle assertion written: jsdom does not resolve styled-components class-selector min-height, so such a test would be false-confidence (advisor).
